prompt:
The moment a red cricket ball shatters the stumps on a dusty Indian pitch, bails flying through the air, the bat lying in the dust, a stadium and floodlights behind, a burst of dust. Painted like a vintage Indian sports-magazine centre spread from the 1980s: deep outfield greens, chalk white and cherry red, dramatic angle, faded glossy print. Wide panoramic composition: the main subject sits in the left third of the frame. Towards the right the same scene carries on, quieter and darker: open sky, distance and shadow, nothing important there, one continuous picture with no panels and no split. Full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no people, no faces, no hands. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no badges, no religious symbols, no writing anywhere.
